q1.question: What is UrTraining and how does it work?
q1.answer: UrTraining is a web-based platform for creating, distributing, and following personalized training plans. Users receive AI-assisted workout recommendations based on their fitness goals and preferences. Trainers can upload and manage their own structured programs for users to follow.

q2.question: Do I need to register to browse the courses?
q2.answer: Currently, registration is required to access full course details. We are working on adding preview options for unregistered users.

q3.question: How long does the personalization questionnaire take?
q3.answer: It takes about 3–5 minutes and helps tailor the training plan to your needs or recommend your plans to the right audience (for trainers).

q4.question: Is the platform free to use?
q4.answer: Yes, UrTraining is free. However, we may introduce paid features in the future for advanced tools or monetization options.

q5.question: How do I start a workout or course after registering?
q5.answer: Once registered and the questionnaire is complete, you'll receive workout recommendations and can start directly from the catalog. Your active programs appear in your profile.

q6.question: How do I switch between trainer and trainee roles?
q6.answer: The role is selected during registration and currently cannot be changed. You can log out and create a new account. Role-switching will be available in future updates.

q7.question: What kind of workouts are available on the platform?
q7.answer: We currently offer strength training, cardio, HIIT, yoga, pilates, functional training, CrossFit, bodybuilding, stretching, running, swimming, cycling, boxing, and dancing... You can upload your own training type - the structure of training plan is uniform!

q8.question: How are personalized workouts generated?
q8.answer: After completing the questionnaire, AI selects and adjusts workouts based on your fitness level, goals, preferences, and available equipment. Workouts are authored by qualified trainers. Recommendational model considers all the aspects of your training process to propose you the best options.

q9.question: Will I receive money for creating the courses?
q9.answer: At the moment, there is no monetization. However, trainer compensation features are being considered for future updates.

q10.question: Why do I need to add certificates of my education?
q10.answer: Certificates help verify your qualifications and build user trust. Verified trainers may receive more visibility on the platform.

q11.question: What if I have a workout type not listed in the predefined list?
q11.answer: We are continuously expanding the list. Feel free to suggest new workout categories.

q12.question: Can I upload photos of the exercise plan?
q12.answer: Photo and video support for exercise plans is in development. Stay tuned for future updates.

q13.question: Is there a Russian version of the platform?
q13.answer: Yes, just switch the language using the navbar button.

q14.question: What are the terms I agree to during registration?
q14.answer: You agree to our terms of service, which cover content usage, data privacy, user conduct, and platform policies.

q15.question: How do I log out of my account?
q15.answer: Just go to your profile page and click the logout button.
